searchText: Yesterday was a really great teaching moment and a great simulator for mainnet launch for everyone involved (implementation teams, staking services, infra and so on). I know we at blox would love 1-2 more opportunities to test that first phase of activation. If we can have a few resets as part of the multi client testnet that could be really great. <@!311971895828283393> <@!399309815517544451> idk if that's a ludicrous idea, would love your input. If you look at the participation chart you can see when people go to bed at 23:00. Many people probably don't have a dedicated machine for staking and turn their PC off. On the testnet they don't need to run a dedicated node because there is nothing at stake at the moment. I would expect mainnet participation and finalization to be generally better simply because there is actually something at stake which is the whole point of Proof of Stake. Of course nodes are spread all over the world but there is a high concentration in Europe and the US. I would attribute the low initial participation to last minute updates to clients to get the bootnodes going. You could see on eth2stats that many nodes were sitting at 0 peers and prysm is currently run by the majority of people. This can be solved by having a longer genesis_delay. Ok, I'm running validators on Ligthhouse, Prysm, Teku, and Nimbus now. Still figuring out Lodestar 🙂 Just a quick reminder, Sacha and I created a repo to track UX reports from Twitter/Reddit/etc so that they are in a convenient place for us: https://github.com/eth2-clients/user-experience Last round of participation was only 64% From eth2stats.io it looks like there's several prysm nodes not aggregating attestations any more, including mine. Can't verify right now since I don't have access to the machine. yeah, I'm seeing some issues too <@!363800010518822915> How can you tell that Prysm isn’t aggregating attestations from eth2stats? <@645357884300853258> <@291925846556540928> anything you can share about your issues? Any interesting logs? I mainly just noticed a number of prysm users that have missing attestations on beaconcha.in in past few epochs https://beaconcha.in/validators/eth1deposits?q=0xcDbe9b868F34BeE1B4d8ddb179dEA19702223D91 see here it _seems_ that this has affected some of the prylabs vals example https://beaconcha.in/validator/0xac7e0f2b62ce54d97e82788c0f68d1f41fe7b2dd1c4e24c61f6524dbed36e481d33f3141c20a4bacbdc9a5ac69a885c1#attestations I can check our nodes/vals and see if we are having that issues or not <@399309815517544451> Usually the "Attestations" column shows a value >> 0, I figured it shows the number of collected attestations. Not sure about that though. I think that’s number is higher because there are more distinct attestations at the moment regarding attestations, one thing we're consistently seeing is very old attestations travelling in the network, ie right on the cusp where they should not be included if anyone else is seeing this, ping us please - it could also be a buildup in a queue, we're investigating We are aware of 3 high priority fixes that are ready. We're preparing a new release off our normal schedule and it should be available within the next hour. we just finalized again it seems thanks <@!399309815517544451> <@!557201004060213248> your validators are offline 🙂
